name: check_availability
description: Check open appointment slots on the business's Cal.com calendar for a given date range. Call this before offering any time to a caller — never guess a slot is free.

username.description: The business's Cal.com username, e.g. joesturdy

eventTypeSlug.description: The bookable event type slug for the requested service, e.g. haircut-30min

start.description: ISO 8601 start of the search window, e.g. 2026-08-18T00:00:00Z

end.description: ISO 8601 end of the search window, e.g. 2026-08-19T23:59:59Z
